plugins.name: faf-memory
plugins.description: etch and forget. Persistent AI memory in IANA-registered .fafm (application/vnd.fafm+yaml). Cross-vendor — Claude, Cursor, Grok, Gemini all read the same memory. Etch a fact once, recall it in any future session. No more session-zero blank slate. Nelly Never Forgets (so you can!).
